executionRule: completed-bar signal -> next-bar-open fill; same-bar stop/target -> stop first; explicit friction; no broker orders
promotionRule: No automatic promotion. New version only after prospective review; never rewrite historical rules.

opening.name: 갭하락 플러시 → VWAP·시초가 재탈환
opening.rule: 시가 -2~-8% 갭하락 → 첫 5분 추가 하락≥1% → 09:05~09:35 VWAP와 시초가 재탈환 + 거래량 1.2배 → 다음 1분봉 시가 진입 · -0.8%/+1.8% · 10:00 청산
opening.reviewPolicy: Rules stay frozen. Review after >=20 prospective days AND >=20 prospective trades; positive daily expectancy, PF>=1.10, MDD>=-15%, worst day>=-8%. No automatic live promotion.
opening.targetNote: +1% day / +5% week are research thresholds, not guaranteed returns.

daytrading.name: 시장 상대강도 + VWAP 재탈환
daytrading.rule: 10:05~14:30 시장대비 상대강도≥1%p · 당일 +0.5~+6% · VWAP 아래→위 재탈환 · 거래량 1.2배 · 직전3분 고점 회복 → 다음 1분봉 시가 · -0.8%/+1.6% · 최대60분/15:10
daytrading.reviewPolicy: Rules stay frozen. Review after >=20 prospective days AND >=20 prospective trades; positive daily expectancy, PF>=1.10, MDD>=-15%, worst day>=-8%. No automatic live promotion.
daytrading.targetNote: +1% day / +5% week are research thresholds, not guaranteed returns.
